claim.quote: We report in this paper the results of several runs (of about 10 days each) with successively improved energy thresholds, and the progressive background reduction obtained by improvement of the radiopurity of the components

name: First results of the ROSEBUD Dark Matter experiment

summary.plain: The first runs of ROSEBUD's tiny sapphire detectors at Canfranc, showing how the background fell as materials were cleaned and the energy threshold was lowered.
summary.technical: Three sapphire bolometers (100 g in total) with NTD-Ge sensors at 20 mK in Canfranc (2450 m.w.e.); runs of about 10 days with successively lower thresholds and background after radiopurity improvements and the addition of old (Roman) lead shields.

title: First results of the ROSEBUD Dark Matter experiment
why_it_matters: Set the baseline for low-mass WIMP searches with sapphire bolometers at Canfranc and showed where the background came from.
